name: File Upload
description: Accessible drag-and-drop file uploader with an animated folder and per-file progress states.
summary: A dotted upload dropzone built around the native file input. Its muted black folder opens on hover or focus, while queued files expose progress, success, failure, cancellation, retry, and removal states.
highlights: Black folder with a fine white outline, grey offset shadow, and hinged hover opening
Native picker plus drag-and-drop interaction with dotted border feedback
Per-file upload progress, success, failure, cancellation, retry, and removal states
File count, size, and accepted-type validation

physics.description: The folder flap opens from its lower hinge with a restrained back ease, revealing the folder mouth, then closes when hover or focus leaves.

accessibility.aria: The dropzone is keyboard operable, each progress bar names its file, and status changes are announced politely.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The folder transitions immediately between open and closed states when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

keyboard.description: Moves between the dropzone and available file actions.

recommended: Attachment fields, media uploads, and import workflows
bestPractices: Keep accepted types and limits visible
Surface server errors through rejected promises
